prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were generally overly optimistic overall, but underestimated gains for winning tests.
Reordering sign-in (sign_in, reorder), home notifications (home, notification), adoption new flows (adoption, new_flow), choose path layouts (choose_path, layout), and finish new flows (finish, new_flow) proved helpful, generating multiple winning tests.
New finish screens (finish, new_screen) and finish redesigns (finish, redesign) consistently led to negative impacts or guardrail rollbacks across multiple tests.
Finish hints (finish, hint), finish incentives (finish, incentive), home hints (home, hint), sign-in copy tweaks (sign_in, copy), choose path copy (choose_path, copy), and sign-in notifications (sign_in, notification) consistently showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
Evidence remains thin for change kinds tested only once (including adoption incentive, adoption wait_info, choose_path hint/incentive/new_flow, sign_in layout, and sign_in new_flow), requiring at least 2 tests to state a pattern.

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Reorder Sign In After Pick Friend Screen: Move the sign-in step to immediately follow pet selection on the pick friend screen so account creation locks in the chosen pet. (why: Support emails show 8 reports of missing/reset pets after sign-in, and sign-in reordering has proven effective in past iterations.)
1: [adoption, new_flow] Pick Friend Interactive Voice Preview Flow: Add audio play buttons and animated preview components to pet option cards so users can sample companion sound effects before adopting. (why: Adoption has a 24.3% drop-off and high completion time (median 89s). Interactive adoption flows have yielded positive historic gains.)
2: [home, notification] Waiting Screen Habitat Sound Notification: Add an active sound alert component and desktop readiness toggle on the waiting screen to announce when habitat generation finishes. (why: The waiting screen has a very high mean time (2336s). Home notification changes have proven helpful in past cycles.)
3: [adoption, redesign] Upload Photos Stage Layout Redesign: Redesign the custom photo upload step using a stage layout that displays real-time custom pet asset visual updates. (why: Support logged 3 emails regarding failed or malformed custom pet generations during adoption.)
4: [choose_path, new_screen] New Choose Path Option Selection Screen: Insert a dedicated companion mode selection screen after the story screen to let users pick active versus focus desktop pet behaviors. (why: Choose path is the first major funnel drop-off (21.5%). Structuring path choices into clear dedicated steps sets proper user expectations.)
5: [finish, new_flow] Home Intro Companion Audio Controls Flow: Add an interactive audio sample and desktop controls visual preview component to the final intro screen to teach desktop controls. (why: Support received 3 emails about confusion on controlling or hiding the pet. Finish step new flows have historically performed well.)
6: [adoption, layout] Pick Friend Two Column Layout Refresh: Switch the pet selection screen to a two-column layout showing pet animations on one side and traits on the other. (why: Adoption has a high completion time (median 89s, mean 1017s). A side-by-side comparison speeds up decision making.)
7: [home, notification] Waiting Screen Desktop Habitat Status Banner Notification: Display an active status banner badge on the waiting screen updating users on desktop pet asset rendering progress. (why: Support received 3 emails about pets not opening on desktop, and home step notification features have proven helpful.)
8: [choose_path, layout] Choose Path Spotlight Layout Refresh: Rebuild the path selection screen with a spotlight layout highlighting key features of each usage path. (why: Choose path is the first drop-off point (78.5% conversion). Choose path layout changes have consistently driven historical wins.)
